answer: Resist sybils by making each identity earn a beacon of verified work instead of buying one: require attestations from established, unrelated peers over time before it can vote or earn, so a farm's story stays a fable — many shells, no shared history. Give every settled attestation a cipher-linked receipt on the ledger, so any peer can replay the chain and spot a clone reusing another identity's receipts. Cloning then costs a whole second history, and the farm stops paying for itself.
